decisions.title: Two years old, among other children
decisions.body: Rangga can walk quite well now. Where the neighborhood children play together, what does the child do first? What you pick leans the child's temperament that way; moments like these add up, and it settles by about age five.
decisions.fact: Temperament comes from what we are born with and what happens as we grow. Twin studies put about 40% of the differences in personality down to genes (Vukasović & Bratko 2015)

logs.t: In January undefined, you were born a boy in rural West Java, Indonesia, into a family in the bottom 20–40%. You are the firstborn. Your family's religion is Islam.
You got your basic vaccinations (DTP and measles).
You took your first steps. The whole family clapped.
You said your first word: ‘Mama’.
You spent Eid al-Adha (the Feast of Sacrifice) with your family.
You fell more than once, and in the end you caught up with the older children.
Your paternal grandmother told you stories from long ago.
You started preschool.
You played in the mud and got your clothes filthy.
A younger brother was born.
Sitting next to your parents, you watched a video on the internet for the first time.
You played with the neighborhood kids until the sun went down.
You sat beside your maternal grandfather looking at old photographs for a long time.

In January undefined, you were born a girl in rural Central Russia, Russia, into a family in the top 20–40%. You have an older sister aged 2. Your family's religion is Islam. Your family's roots: Tatar.
You got your basic vaccinations (DTP and measles).
The war between Russia and Ukraine that began in 2022 was still going on the year you were born.
You said your first word: ‘Mama’.
You took your first steps. The whole family clapped.
Your paternal grandmother told you stories from long ago.
You tried again and again, and at last you did it by yourself.
Every night before bed, your parents read you picture books.
You played with the neighborhood kids until the sun went down.
You started preschool.
Sitting next to your parents, you watched a video on the internet for the first time.
A younger brother was born.
You spent the New Year holiday with your family.
You sat beside your maternal grandfather looking at old photographs for a long time.
In January undefined, you were born a girl in rural southern areas, Côte d'Ivoire, into one of the richest 20% of families. You have 4 older siblings. Your family has no particular religion.
You got your basic vaccinations (DTP and measles).
You said your first word: ‘Mama’.
You took your first steps. The whole family clapped.
You spent the New Year holiday with your family.
You fell more than once, and in the end you caught up with the older children.
Every night before bed, your parents read you picture books.
A younger brother was born.
You played in the mud and got your clothes filthy.
You started preschool.
At home, meals were cooked over a smoky fire. When smoke filled the kitchen, your eyes stung and you coughed.
